About the role
Join the Applied ML team to train and evaluate computer vision models that detect defects in manufacturing images.

What you'll do
- Build training pipelines in PyTorch and run experiments on GPU clusters
- Improve model accuracy with data augmentation and hyperparameter tuning
- Package models for low-latency inference

Qualifications
- Coursework in deep learning or computer vision
- Python, NumPy, PyTorch or TensorFlow
- Bonus: CUDA, ONNX, experiment tracking

Responsibilities
Build accessible, responsive user interfaces for our customer dashboard using React and TypeScript. Partner with designers to turn Figma mocks into components, write unit tests with Jest, and improve page performance.

Requirements
- JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML, CSS
- Experience with React or a similar framework
- Care for accessibility (WCAG) and web performance

What you'll do
Analyze product usage data with SQL, build Tableau dashboards for the growth team, and present weekly insights to stakeholders. Design and analyze A/B tests to measure the impact of product changes.

Qualifications
- Strong SQL and spreadsheet skills
- Statistics coursework (hypothesis testing, regression)
- Clear written communication

Summer Analysts support deal teams on mergers and acquisitions. You will build three-statement financial models and discounted cash flow (DCF) valuations in Excel, prepare pitch books in PowerPoint, and research comparable companies.

Qualifications
- Finance, accounting or economics coursework
- Advanced Excel modeling
- Ability to work long hours in a fast-paced environment

About the team
Our SRE team keeps Relecloud's services available 24/7. As an intern you will join the on-call rotation with a mentor, write runbooks, and automate incident response.

You will
- Manage services on Kubernetes and Terraform
- Build Prometheus/Grafana alerts and reduce alert noise
- Run postmortems after outages

Requirements: Linux, networking basics, Go or Python scripting

As a Product Design Intern you'll own end-to-end design for a feature: user interviews, journey maps, wireframes and high-fidelity prototypes in Figma. You'll run usability tests and iterate based on findings.

What we're looking for
- A portfolio showing your design process
- Figma, prototyping, visual design fundamentals
- Curiosity about users

Quantitative Research Interns develop and backtest systematic trading signals. You'll work with large time-series datasets, apply stochastic calculus and probability to price derivatives, and implement research in Python and C++.

Qualifications
- Mathematics, physics, statistics or CS major
- Probability, linear algebra, stochastic processes
- Python; C++ a plus

Write firmware in C for the microcontrollers inside our connected toys. You'll bring up new hardware boards, debug with oscilloscopes and logic analyzers, and optimize power consumption for battery-powered devices.

Requirements
- C programming, interrupts, RTOS concepts
- Experience with ARM Cortex-M, I2C/SPI/UART
- Electrical or computer engineering coursework
